cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Вспомни о том, как ты наставлял многих и укреплял ослабевшие ___.
cases.translation: Remember how you instructed many and strengthened the weak hands.
cases.explain: The verb 'укреплял' (strengthened) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Слова твои были падающим ___, и дрожащие колени ты укреплял.
cases.translation: Your words were a support to the falling, and you strengthened the trembling knees.
cases.explain: The verb 'были' (were) governs the instrumental case for predicate nouns.

cases.sentence: А теперь тебя постигли беды, и ты изнемог. Тебя коснулось несчастье, и ты устрашен в ___.
cases.translation: But now trouble has come upon you, and you are weakened; misfortune has touched you, and you are dismayed in an instant.
cases.explain: The adverbial expression of time uses the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я видел, что те, кто вспахивает несчастье и сеет беду, их и ___.
cases.translation: I have seen that those who plow iniquity and sow trouble reap the same.
cases.explain: The third person plural present tense of the verb 'пожинать' (to reap).

cases.sentence: От дуновения Божьего исчезают они, и от дыхания его гнева ___.
cases.translation: By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of His anger they are consumed.
cases.explain: The third person plural present tense of 'гибнуть' (to perish).

cases.sentence: Среди беспокойных ночных видений, когда людьми владеет глубокий сон, меня объяли страх и ___, и я задрожал всем телом.
cases.translation: Amid disquieting nighttime visions, when deep sleep falls on men, fear and trembling seized me, and I shook in all my limbs.
cases.explain: The verb 'объяли' (seized) governs the accusative case for the object.

cases.sentence: Может ли смертный быть пред Богом праведен, а ___  пред Создателем чист?
cases.translation: Can a mortal be righteous before God, and can a man be pure before his Maker?
cases.explain: The noun 'человек' is the subject of the clause and uses the nominative case.

reading.ru: Если кто-нибудь решится сказать тебе слово, не досадит ли тебе?
reading.question: What does Eliphaz ask Job at the beginning of his speech?
options: Whether it would grieve Job if someone spoke to him
Whether Job would listen to words of comfort
Whether Job wanted to hear words of condemnation
Whether Job would reject all words of wisdom
reading.correct: Whether it would grieve Job if someone spoke to him
reading.explain: Eliphaz's opening question: 'Если кто-нибудь решится сказать тебе слово, не досадит ли тебе?' (If someone ventures to speak to you, would it not grieve you?).

reading.ru: Вспомни о том, как ты наставлял многих и укреплял ослабевшие руки.
reading.question: What does Eliphaz recall about Job's past character?
options: He had instructed many and strengthened the weak hands
He had judged the wicked and punished the unjust
He had built a great kingdom and amassed wealth
He had performed miracles and healed the sick
reading.correct: He had instructed many and strengthened the weak hands
reading.explain: Eliphaz reminds Job: 'ты наставлял многих и укреплял ослабевшие руки' (you instructed many and strengthened weak hands).

reading.ru: Праведные не страдают от гнева Бога. Подумай, случалось ли гибнуть справеднику?
reading.question: What is Eliphaz's assertion about the righteous and the wicked?
options: The righteous do not suffer from God's wrath; the upright do not perish
Both the righteous and wicked suffer equally in life
The righteous suffer more than the wicked to test their faith
God punishes all people regardless of their righteousness
reading.correct: The righteous do not suffer from God's wrath; the upright do not perish
reading.explain: Eliphaz's teaching: 'Праведные не страдают от гнева Бога. Подумай, случалось ли гибнуть справеднику?' (The righteous do not suffer from God's wrath; have you ever known the upright to perish?).

reading.ru: Я видел, что те, кто вспахивает несчастье и сеет беду, их и пожинают.
reading.question: What does Eliphaz say about those who sow trouble?
options: God protects them from their own schemes
They receive mercy despite their wickedness
They are saved by the prayers of the righteous
reading.explain: Eliphaz's observation: 'те, кто вспахивает несчастье и сеет беду, их и пожинают' (those who plow iniquity and sow trouble reap the same).

reading.ru: Ко мне прокралось слово, но я уловил лишь отзвук его.
reading.question: What happened to Eliphaz during his nighttime vision?
options: A word crept to him but he caught only its whisper
He heard a clear message directly from God
A vision appeared but he did not understand it
He received a prophecy about Job's future
reading.correct: A word crept to him but he caught only its whisper
reading.explain: Eliphaz describes: 'Ко мне прокралось слово, но я уловил лишь отзвук его' (A word crept to me, but I caught only a whisper of it).

reading.ru: Если Бог не доверяет даже своим слугам, если даже в ангелах находит недостатки, то что говорить о живущих в домах из глины, чье основание прах?
reading.question: What does Eliphaz say about human purity compared to God's servants?
options: If God finds fault with His servants and angels, how much more with those in clay houses
Humans are purer than angels because they live in material form
God trusts humans completely and finds no fault in them
No one can understand God's relationship with His servants
reading.correct: If God finds fault with His servants and angels, how much more with those in clay houses
reading.explain: Eliphaz's rhetorical argument: 'Если Бог не доверяет...своим слугам...если даже в ангелах находит недостатки...то что говорить о живущих в домах из глины' (If God puts no trust in His servants and finds fault with His angels, how much more those who dwell in houses of clay).
